title: IntelSky military aircraft
description: Military and government aircraft worldwide from IntelSky (intelsky.org), polled from its live feed. No API key; IntelSky allows 60 live requests a minute per IP and asks commercial or high-volume users to contact it first.

intervalSec.title: Poll interval (s)
intervalSec.description: IntelSky refreshes its feed about every 8 s
